This article analyzes Appendikstabel 6: Typer og antal behandlinger med BMSL (indikator 5), which tracks the types and volumes of [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (BMSL) treatments administered to children and adults. The data covers the period from October 1, 2024, to September 30, 2025 [^src1]. Because this table represents a single reporting period, no longitudinal trends can be established from this data alone [^src1].

[[bohj18a1-behandling-med-infliximab|BOHJ18A1 - Behandling med infliximab]] is the clear leader across both demographics, accounting for 1,805 (64%) of the 2,838 total pediatric treatments and 27,673 (41%) of the 67,499 total adult treatments [^src1]. For children, the second most common treatment is [[bohj19h4-behandling-med-vedolizumab|BOHJ19H4 - Behandling med vedolizumab]] with 453 treatments (16%), while for adults, [[bohj18a3-behandling-med-adalimumab|BOHJ18A3 - Behandling med adalimumab]] ranks second with 12,657 treatments (19%) [^src1].

Several treatments appear as outliers with zero recorded adult usage during this period. These include BOHJ18B7 - Behandling med guselkumab (0 adults), [[bwhp141-behandling-med-filgotinib|BWHP141]] (0 adults), [[bwhp143-behandling-med-ozanimod|BWHP143]] (0 adults), and [[bwhp148-behandling-med-etrasimod|BWHP148]] (0 adults) [^src1]. Notably, [[bwhp141-behandling-med-filgotinib|BWHP141]] records 203 pediatric treatments despite showing 0% in the percentage column and zero adult treatments, highlighting a stark demographic divergence in its usage [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen opsummerer antallet af BMSL-behandlinger pr. kode i perioden 1/10/2024–30/9/2025, og viser at infliximab (BOHJ18A1) er den hyppigst anvendte behandling både blandt børn og voksne.
